ref_atoms.ref_content: ASID.INTERSIG.MUBI: Destination and source ASID signals are multibit encoded.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名ASID信号并明确要求multibit encoded。

ref_atoms.ref_content: RANGE.CONFIG.REGWEN_MUBI: DMA enabled memory range is software multibit lockable.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名DMA使能内存范围的配置寄存器并且明确要求multibit lockable。

ref_atoms.ref_content: fatal_fault: This fatal alert is triggered when a fatal TL-UL bus integrity fault is detected.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名fatal_fault告警并明确触发条件为检测到致命TL-UL总线完整性故障。

ref_atoms.ref_content: SRC_ADDR_LO: Lower 32 bits of the physical or virtual address of memory location within SoC memory address map or physical address within OT non-secure memory space. Data is read from this location in a copy operation. Must be aligned to the transfer width.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名SRC_ADDR_LO寄存器并明确要求必须对齐到传输宽度。

ref_atoms.ref_content: SRC_ADDR_HI: Upper 32 bits of the source address. Must be aligned to the transfer width. Source and destination address must have the same alignment.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名SRC_ADDR_HI寄存器并明确要求必须对齐到传输宽度且源与目的地址对齐一致。

ref_atoms.ref_content: DST_ADDR_LO: Lower 32 bits of the physical or virtual address of memory location within SoC memory address map or physical address within OT non-secure memory space. Data is written to this location in a copy operation. Must be aligned to the transfer width. Source and destination address must have the same alignment.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名DST_ADDR_LO寄存器并明确要求必须对齐到传输宽度且源与目的地址对齐一致。

ref_atoms.ref_content: DST_ADDR_HI: Upper 32 bits of the destination address. Must be aligned to the transfer width. Source and destination address must have the same alignment.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名DST_ADDR_HI寄存器并明确要求必须对齐到传输宽度且源与目的地址对齐一致。

ref_atoms.ref_content: RANGE_VALID: Indicates that the ENABLED_MEMORY_RANGE_BASE and _LIMIT registers have been programmed to restrict DMA accesses within the OT internal address space. Once set the enabled memory base and limit registers are valid.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名RANGE_VALID寄存器，明确设置后使能内存范围限制。

ref_atoms.ref_content: RANGE_REGWEN: Used by firmware to lock the DMA enabled memory range configuration registers from further modification. Once this register is set to kMultiBitBool4False, it can only be set to kMultiBitBool4True through a reset event. Default Value = kMultiBitBool4True -> Unlocked at reset.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名RANGE_REGWEN寄存器，明确其MultiBit编码锁定行为及仅可通过复位从False变为True。

ref_atoms.ref_content: CFG_REGWEN: Indicates whether the configuration registers are locked because the DMA controller is operating. In the idle state, this register is set to kMultiBitBool4True. When the DMA is performing an operation, i.e., the DMA is busy, this register is set to kMultiBitBool4False. During the DMA operation, the CONTROL and STATUS registers remain usable. The comportable registers (the interrupt and alert configuration) are NOT locked during the DMA operation and can still be updated.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名CFG_REGWEN寄存器，明确其在DMA空闲和忙碌状态下的加锁行为，以及哪些寄存器受影响。

ref_atoms.ref_content: TOTAL_DATA_SIZE: Total size (in bytes) of the data blob involved in DMA movement for multiple transfers. Minimum: 1 byte. Maximum: May be restricted to a maximum pre-defined size based on OT DMA enabled memory space allocation. Works in conjunction with Transfer width register.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名TOTAL_DATA_SIZE寄存器，明确最小1字节、最大受内存范围限制的约束。

ref_atoms.ref_content: CHUNK_DATA_SIZE: Size (in bytes) for a single DMA transfer. In hardware handshake mode, the DMA reads in chunks of CHUNK_DATA_SIZE from the peripheral. Minimum: 1 byte. Maximum: May be restricted to a maximum pre-defined size based on OT DMA enabled memory space allocation. Works in conjunction with Transfer width register.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名CHUNK_DATA_SIZE寄存器，明确最小1字节、最大受内存范围限制的约束。

ref_atoms.ref_content: TRANSFER_WIDTH: Denotes the width of each transaction that the DMA shall issue during the data movement. Multiple transactions of this width will be issued until total size number of bytes are reached. Note that the value 3 for this register represents an invalid configuration that leads to an error.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名TRANSFER_WIDTH寄存器，明确值3为无效配置且会导致错误。

ref_atoms.ref_content: CONTROL: Defines the type of DMA operations (opcode: COPY, SHA256, SHA384, SHA512). Hardware handshake enable: Enable hardware handshake mode, DMA reads data from source upon input trigger. Digest swap: If 1, digest output registers are converted to big-endian byte order. Initial transfer: Marks the initial transfer to initialize DMA and SHA engine for one transfer spanning multiple DMA transfers. Abort: Aborts the DMA operation if set, sets status bit once abort complete. Go: Trigger the DMA operation when set; DMA engine clears GO automatically after configured operation complete (except for hardware handshake, where firmware must clear it).
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名CONTROL寄存器，明确其多个字段的硬件行为：opcode、硬件握手、digest_swap、initial_transfer、abort、go。

ref_atoms.ref_content: SRC_CONFIG: wrap: When 1, source address wrapped back to the starting address when finishing a chunk. increment: When 0, source address is not changed (all reads from same address); when 1, source address is incremented by transfer_width after each read.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名SRC_CONFIG寄存器，明确源地址的递增和回绕行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: DST_CONFIG: wrap: When 1, destination address wrapped back to the starting address when finishing a chunk. increment: When 0, destination address is not changed (all writes to same address); when 1, destination address is incremented by transfer_width after each write.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名DST_CONFIG寄存器，明确目标地址的递增和回绕行为。

ref_atoms.ref_content: STATUS: busy: DMA operation is active if set; cleared by DMA engine when operation complete. done: Configured DMA operation is complete; cleared automatically by hardware when starting a new transfer. aborted: Set once aborted operation drains. error: Error occurred during operation; ERROR_CODE register denotes the source. sha2_digest_valid: Indicates whether the SHA2_DIGEST register contains a valid digest; cleared on initial transfer, set when digest is written. chunk_done: Transfer of a single chunk is complete; only raised for multi-chunk memory-to-memory transfers; cleared automatically by hardware when starting a new chunk.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名STATUS寄存器，明确各状态位的硬件设置和清除条件。

ref_atoms.ref_content: ERROR_CODE: src_addr_error: Source address is invalid. dst_addr_error: Destination address is invalid. opcode_error: Opcode is invalid. size_error: TRANSFER_WIDTH encodes an invalid value, TOTAL_DATA_SIZE or CHUNK_SIZE are zero, or inline hashing is not using 32-bit transfer width. bus_error: The bus transfer returned an error. base_limit_error: The base and limit addresses contain an invalid value. range_valid_error: The DMA enabled memory range is not configured. asid_error: The source or destination ASID contains an invalid value. The error is cleared by writing the RW1C STATUS.error register.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名ERROR_CODE寄存器，明确各错误位的具体触发条件。

ref_atoms.ref_content: CLEAR_INTR_SRC: Valid bits for which interrupt sources need clearing. When HANDSHAKE_INTR_ENABLE is non-zero and corresponding lsio_trigger becomes set, DMA issues writes with address from INTR_SRC_ADDR and write value from INTR_SRC_WR_VAL corresponding to each bit set in this register.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名CLEAR_INTR_SRC寄存器及相关行为：当HANDSHAKE_INTR_ENABLE非零且lsio_trigger置位时，DMA根据此寄存器发起清除写的逻辑。

ref_atoms.ref_content: CLEAR_INTR_BUS: Bus selection bit for source N, where 0 selects CTN/System fabric and 1 selects OT-internal crossbar, used to direct the clearing command for interrupt sources.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: 指名CLEAR_INTR_BUS寄存器，明确用于选择中断清除写操作的目标总线（CTN/System或OT内部交叉开关）。

ref_atoms.ref_content: Smoke test in which random DMA operations are performed with 'memory-to-memory' mode. Stimulus: Configure DMA randomizing memory region base/limit, source/destination address space IDs and pointers, total transfer width, transaction size; program DMAC.op_code and disable hardware_handshake; start by setting DMAC.GO bit; wait for TLUL transactions on output interface; respond with data from TLUL agent; wait for completion; repeat. Checking: data at source TLUL interface appears unchanged on destination; PLIC interrupt if INTR_ENABLE.int_enable else DMAC.DONE after each iteration; no spurious requests from other TLUL interfaces; number of TLUL requests matches expected data size; DMAC.busy bit set throughout operation in each iteration.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes specific register behaviours (DMAC.GO, DMAC.busy, DMAC.DONE, INTR_ENABLE.int_enable) and precise checking conditions.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Smoke test in which 'hardware handshake' DMA operations are performed. Stimulus: Configure DMA randomizing memory region base/limit, source/dest ASIDs and pointers, total transfer width, transaction sizes; program DMAC.op_code and enable 'hardware handshake' mode; start by setting DMAC.GO bit; assert Low Speed IO (LSIO) interrupt; wait for TLUL transaction; respond with random number of data items; deassert LSIO interrupt; wait for completion; repeat. Checking: data unchanged on destination; PLIC interrupt if INTR_ENABLE.int_enable else DMAC.DONE; number of requests matches expected size; STATUS.busy bit set until 'hardware handshake' mode is disabled; STATUS.done set after LSIO interrupt deasserted.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes specific register/status behaviours (STATUS.busy, STATUS.done, DMAC.DONE, LSIO interrupt) with precise checking conditions.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Smoke test with both 'memory-to-memory' and 'hardware handshaking' transfers. FW allocates DMA enabled Memory Space, configures Source Address and ASID, Destination Address and ASID, Operation Size, Opcode; triggers DMA operation; FW either polls for completion or waits for Completion Interrupt; reset memory contents at end of iteration.

Test to check DMA memory region lock functionality. Stimulus: Configure DMA randomizing memory region base/limit, source/dest ASIDs and pointers, total transfer width, transaction size; lock DMA memory configuration registers; program DMAC.op_code and randomize 'hardware handshake' mode enable; start by setting DMAC.GO bit; randomly change memory region base and limit; wait for completion; reset design by asserting rst_n; repeat without locking. Checking: write to DMA memory region base/limit ignored until range_regwen.regwen is cleared; range_regwen.regwen set to MuBi4True after deassertion of reset; interrupt if INTR_ENABLE.int_enable else DMAC.DONE.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies exact register gating behaviour (range_regwen.regwen clears writes, MuBi4True after reset) and associated checkpoints.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Test to check TLUL error behaviour on DMA interfaces. Stimulus: Configure DMA for 'memory-to-memory' mode; start with DMAC.GO; respond with error on either source or destination TLUL request; wait for PLIC interrupt if INTR_ENABLE.int_enable else poll for DMAC.ABORTED bit. Checking: STATUS.aborted bit set; no further TLUL transactions on source/dest after error; DMA generates an alert.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes exact error response behaviour: STATUS.aborted assertion, TLUL transaction cessation, alert generation.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Test to check TLUL error behaviour on DMA interfaces with 'hardware handshake' mode. Stimulus: Configure DMA in hardware_handshake mode; start with DMAC.GO; respond with error on destination TLUL interface; wait for interrupt if INTR_ENABLE.int_enable else poll for DMAC.DONE bit. Checking: no TLUL transactions on destination interface after error; STATUS.aborted bit set; DMA generates an alert.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes error behaviour with specific signals (STATUS.aborted, DMAC.DONE, alert) and transaction cessation.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Stress test in which hardware handshake DMA operations are performed to achieve maximum coverage. Stimulus: Configure DMA randomizing memory region, ASIDs, total transfer width, transaction size, DMAC.data_direction, DMAC.FIFO_addr_auto_increment_enable, DMAC.memory_addr_auto_increment_enable; program DMAC.op_code and enable 'hardware handshake' mode; start with DMAC.GO; assert LSIO interrupt; wait for TLUL transaction; respond with random data; deassert LSIO interrupt; wait for completion. Checking: DMAC.GO bit not set until DMA operation complete; STATUS.busy bit set until 'hardware handshake' mode disabled; STATUS.done set after LSIO interrupt deasserted.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies concrete hardware behaviours of DMAC.GO, STATUS.busy, STATUS.done under handshake stress.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Stress test in which random DMA operations are performed with 'memory-to-memory' mode. Stimulus: Configure DMA randomizing memory region, ASIDs, total transfer width, transaction size; program DMAC.op_code and disable 'hardware handshake' mode; start with DMAC.GO; wait for completion; repeat. Checking: number of TLUL requests matches expected data size; data unchanged on destination; STATUS.busy bit set until copy operation complete; STATUS.done bit set after copy operation.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Uses specific register/status signals (STATUS.busy, STATUS.done, DMAC.GO) with detailed checking conditions.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Stress test which combines dma_memory_stress and dma_handshake_stress to ensure that both 'memory-to-memory' and 'hardware handshaking' modes are exercised together without intervening resets.

Test to check DMA memory buffer threshold and limit behaviour with 'hardware handshake' mode. Stimulus: Configure DMA for hardware handshake; set memory_buffer_addr_auto_increment; start with DMAC.GO; assert LSIO interrupt; wait for TLUL transaction; deassert LSIO; wait for completion; repeat. Checking: DMAC.GO bit set until DMA operation complete; STATUS.busy bit set until hardware handshake disabled; STATUS.done set after LSIO deasserted; PLIC interrupt asserted when memory_buffer_auto_increment is enabled.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes precise signal behaviour (DMAC.GO, STATUS.busy, STATUS.done, PLIC interrupt condition) related to memory buffer auto-increment.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Test to check DMAC.abort functionality. Stimulus: Configure DMA with random parameters, randomly enable hardware_handshake mode; start operation; abort before completion by setting DMAC.abort; wait for interrupt if INTR_ENABLE.int_enable else poll DMAC.DONE. Checking: STATUS.aborted bit set; all outstanding transactions on OT internal TLUL interface are complete.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Focuses on explicit abort behaviour (DMAC.abort, STATUS.aborted) and transaction completion check.

ref_atoms.ref_content: Run the other tests in random order while injecting TL errors and running automated CSR tests in parallel.

Test to check DMA hardware enforced security check for illegal source or destination address. Stimulus: Configure DMA memory region base/limit; set source/destination address pointers and ASIDs such that address is outside memory region; configure total transfer width, transaction size; enable 'hardware handshake' mode and direction randomly; start DMA operation; wait for interrupt if INTR_ENABLE.int_enable else poll STATUS.abort bit. Checking: STATUS.aborted bit set; DMA generates an alert.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes illegal address detection with concrete signal outcomes (STATUS.aborted, alert).

ref_atoms.ref_content: DMA enabled memory range registers are configured & locked prior to starting any DMA operation. Range registers may be configured by OT firmware at boot time and locked from further modification until next reset.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes the locking mechanism of DMA enabled memory range registers, a specific hardware feature to prevent reconfiguration during operation.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If the configured source address space ID is SOC (CTN or System) and destination address space ID is OT internal, then destination address pointer must lie within the DMA enabled memory range.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies a precise address checking rule based on source/destination address space IDs, verifiable via access violation tests.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If the configured destination address space ID is SOC (CTN or System) and source address space ID is OT internal, then source address pointer must lie within the DMA enabled memory range.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies a precise address checking rule for opposite direction, verifiable via access violation tests.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If source (or destination) address space ID is set to CTN, then read (or write transactions) are sent to CTN port only. If CTN port is configured to be 32 bits, then make sure that the upper 32 bits of the source (or destination) address register pointer are all zeroes.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines CTN port routing and a specific address alignment check for 32-bit CTN configuration, testable via transaction monitoring and address value checks.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If source (or destination) address space ID is set to OT Internal, then read (or write transactions) are sent to OT internal port only. Make sure that the upper 32 bits of the source (or destination) address register pointer are all zeroes.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines OT internal port routing and address alignment, verifiable via transaction monitoring and address value checks.

ref_atoms.ref_content: If source (or destination) address space ID is set to System, then read (or write transactions) are sent to system port only. Full 64 bits of the source (or destination) address pointer is available.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines system port routing and full 64-bit address usage, verifiable via port routing checks.

ref_atoms.ref_content: When Hardware handshake enable is set to 1 and Go bit is set, the DMA engines start listening to input interrupt for hardware handshake operation.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes the combined effect of control bits that activate interrupt listening in hardware handshake mode, testable by observing DMA behavior after configuration.

ref_atoms.ref_content: In hardware handshake receive mode (Data Direction = 0), upon interrupt assertion from the low speed IO peripheral indicating FIFO threshold, the DMA engine reads 'total size' number of bytes from the source address (FIFO) and writes them to the destination buffer, with each read width equal to 'transfer width'. The source and destination addresses are updated according to the auto-increment enable settings.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines the exact data movement behavior in receive hardware handshake mode, including trigger, transfer size, width, and address update dependency, all of which are directly testable.

ref_atoms.ref_content: In hardware handshake transmit mode (Data Direction = 1), upon interrupt assertion from the low speed IO peripheral indicating FIFO almost empty, the DMA engine reads 'total size' number of bytes from the source buffer and writes them to the destination address (FIFO), with each write width equal to 'transfer width'. The source and destination addresses are updated according to the auto-increment enable settings.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Defines the exact data movement behavior in transmit hardware handshake mode, including trigger, transfer size, width, and address update dependency, testable via functional tests.

ref_atoms.ref_content: FIFO address auto-increment enable: If set, consecutive 'transfer width' worth of data chunks are popped from the FIFO using consecutive register addresses; if not enabled, consecutive data chunks are popped by repeatedly reading the same register address. For writes (transmit), if set, consecutive 'transfer width' worth of data chunks are pushed to the FIFO using consecutive register addresses; if not enabled, data is written to the same register address. When enabled and the FIFO depth is reached, the FIFO address wraps back to the start address. Data buffer Auto-increment Enable: If set, data shall be loaded into consecutive buffer segments in memory, where each segment is equivalent to 'total size' worth of data. The Destination address (in receive) or Source address (in transmit) register is incremented by 'Total Size' once an equivalent amount of data is emptied/filled. If not set, the same buffer segment is overwritten or re-read each time a hardware handshake operation is triggered. All combinations of the two increment enable bits are allowed, and their interaction governs the address behavior as detailed in the appendix.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Describes the detailed behavior of FIFO and data buffer auto-increment controls that determine address generation and buffer reuse, critical for data integrity verification in hardware handshake modes.

ref_atoms.ref_content: DMA controller enforces the following data movement rules based on address space identifiers: OT Private Memory can only send data to OT Private Memory or OT DMA Memory, not to SoC Memory; OT DMA Memory can send to all; SoC Memory cannot send to OT Private Memory but can send to OT DMA Memory or SoC Memory.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Specifies hardware-enforced data movement permissions between address spaces, defining which transfers are allowed and which are forbidden, testable via illegal access attempts.

ref_atoms.ref_content: DMA controller provides status registers that can be polled to track operation completion, and generates a completion interrupt upon finishing a DMA operation.
ref_atoms.kind_reason: Indicates the existence of status registers and completion interrupt as hardware mechanisms observable during verification.
